Subject: Clarifications on RFQ: Corrugated boxes - FY2026-27 annual rate contract

Dear Om Sai Box Works Team,

Thank you for submitting your quote for our corrugated boxes RFQ (FY2026-27 annual rate contract). Please provide clarifications on the items below:

1. Could you please provide your price quotes or confirm if you are not bidding for line 26 (Promo gift-pack outer, 450x350x250 mm, 5-ply), line 28 (Export edible oil 15L tin x 2 carton, 620x330x400 mm, 7-ply), and line 29 (Pallet-load spice drum outer, 580x400x450 mm, 7-ply)?
2. For the 27 lines where freight is not stated, could you please confirm the freight cost per box to our Chakan MIDC plant for 3-ply, 5-ply, and 7-ply boxes, or confirm if your rates are delivered (FOR Chakan)?
3. Could you please confirm or re-send the quoted price for line 14, as it is illegible in your submission?
4. Could you please provide your completed response to our quality questionnaire, along with your ISO 9001 certificate and a recent bursting-strength test report?

We look forward to your response.

Regards,
Category Buyer, Sahyadri Consumer Products Ltd, Chakan MIDC, Pune
